subject: Banking
title: The Microsoft-Activision Saga
description: A quick win: understand The Microsoft-Activision Saga.

hook.text: Microsoft paid $69 billion for Activision Blizzard in 2023. It was the largest gaming acquisition in history.

buildup.text: The deal gave Microsoft Call of Duty, World of Warcraft, and Candy Crush.

discovery.text: UK, EU, and US regulators challenged the deal. Concerns centered on Microsoft gaining too much power in cloud gaming.

twist.text: Microsoft offered concessions including licensing Call of Duty to rivals for 10 years.

climax.text: The Activision deal showed that mega-mergers now require global regulatory approval.

punchline.text: $69 billion, 21 months, three continents of regulators. Welcome to mega-deals.

quiz.question: What concession helped Microsoft close the Activision deal?
options: Licensing Call of Duty to rival platforms for 10 years
